$comment: One item in library/pf1e/items/<slug>.json (or a campaign's own in campaigns/<c>/dm/items/<slug>.json). scripts/gear.py reads it for prices, weights and what a shop buys. Base items only: masterwork, enhancement (+1…) and size are modifiers on an inventory entry, priced by the rules (library/pf1e/rules/equipment-economy.md).

name.description: the item's name as players know it

price.description: in gp per unit (0.1 = 1 sp, 0.01 = 1 cp), for the Medium version

unit.description: how many pieces the price and weight are for (arrows: 20); default 1

weight.description: in lbs per unit, Medium version

str_rating_price.description: composite bows: the extra price in gp per point of Strength rating

sells_full.description: sells at full value (trade goods, gems, art objects); default: half

charges.description: maximum charges (a wand: 50); a sale is prorated by the charges left

consumable.description: used up when used (potions, scrolls, alchemical items): `use` removes one

ammunition.description: the ammunition it fires (arrows, bolts, bullets)

source.description: where the numbers come from (an allowed site's URL, or 'campaign')
